name: Himeji Mahori
source:
A formerly suicidal schoolgirl, who currently serves as a religious leader. She searches for devil worshippers across the world, actively recruiting them in order to attain a certain goal.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/12/30/kasutera/]official website[/url]]
